title: Pure Vampire
summary: Pure Vampire control and undead theft strategy, featuring noble DARK Zombie monsters that pay Life Points to swarm the field, mill the opponent's Deck, and claim enemy monsters as loyal thralls. The strategy converts fallen opponents into material for devastating Rank 6, Rank 8, and Link plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Vampire Ghost discards a Vampire card to send a Level 4 or lower Vampire from Deck to GY and add a Level 5 or higher Vampire from Deck to hand, while banishing itself from GY for an extra Normal Summon.
Vampire Familiar revives itself from the GY by sending a Vampire card from hand or field, paying 500 LP to search any Vampire monster from your Deck.
Vampire Retainer revives itself from the GY by sending a Vampire card from hand or field, paying 500 LP to search any Vampire Spell or Trap from your Deck.
Vampire Sorcerer adds any DARK Vampire monster or Vampire Spell/Trap from Deck to hand when sent to the GY by the opponent, and banishes itself from GY to perform a Tribute Summon without Tributes.
Vampire's Domain grants an additional Normal Summon of a Vampire monster each turn by paying 500 LP, and restores LP whenever you inflict battle damage.

summary.title: Opening: Vampire Ghost Combo
steps: Normal Summon Vampire Ghost and activate its effect, sending Vampire Familiar from Deck to GY and adding Vampire Voivode (or Scarlet Scourge) to hand.
Activate Vampire Familiar in GY, sending a card from hand to GY to Special Summon itself and pay 500 LP to search Vampire Retainer.
Banish Vampire Ghost from your GY to perform an additional Normal Summon, Tributing Familiar for Vampire Scarlet Scourge.
Scarlet Scourge pays 1000 LP to revive Vampire Familiar from your GY.
Link Summon Vampire Fascinator using Scarlet Scourge and Familiar, setting up non-targeting monster theft.

summary.title: Bosses & Graveyard Theft
points: Vampire Fascinator is a Link-3 boss that targets and Special Summons a monster from the opponent's GY to your field, and tributes a Vampire monster to take control of an opponent's face-up monster until the End Phase.
The Zombie Vampire is a Rank 8 Xyz that treats stolen opponent monsters as Level 8 material, mills 4 cards from both players' Decks, and Special Summons a milled monster to your field.
Dhampir Vampire Sheridan is a Rank 6 Xyz that treats stolen opponent monsters as Level 6 material and detaches 1 material to send any card the opponent controls to the GY.
Vampire Voivode Special Summons up to two monsters from the opponent's GY upon Normal Summon and negates monster effects on the field that share names with monsters in the GY.
Vampire Sucker draws 1 card whenever a Zombie is Special Summoned from either GY and allows you to Tribute opponent's Zombie monsters for Tribute Summons.
Vampire Fraulein Special Summons itself from hand when an attack is declared and pays up to 3000 LP during damage calculation to boost a battling Zombie's ATK and DEF.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Vampire Domination is a Counter Trap that negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a Vampire monster, destroying the card and restoring LP equal to its ATK.
Vampire Awakening Special Summons a Vampire monster directly from your Deck in Defense Position, destroying it during the End Phase.
Vampire Kingdom increases all Zombie monsters' ATK by 500 and sends a card from Deck to GY to target and destroy any card on the field whenever a card is sent from the opponent's Deck to the GY.
